root_cause_label: Model saved from dummy random data; real downloaded data never used for training
one_sentence_failure_summary: After downloading real MAPK14 data (silently completed in step 6), the agent trained and saved trained_model.pkl on random dummy data instead, ignored NaN Spearman and constant prediction warnings, and claimed completion without ever retraining on the real dataset.
t_err_evidence: Step 14: fit_model.py is executed with dummy_train.parquet (random SMILES, random targets) and saves trained_model.pkl; output shows 'Training Spearman correlation: nan', meaning the persisted model is trained on meaningless data rather than real MAPK14 data.
t_commit_evidence: Step 16: The agent deletes dummy data files and runs ls, confirming mapk14_1M.parquet is present (102MB, downloaded in step 6) but does not retrain the model on real data. With only step 17 (echo) remaining, failure is now locked in.
t_surface_evidence: Step 14 output: 'Training Spearman correlation: nan' — indicates the model cannot discriminate targets, and step 15 confirms all predictions are identical (0.05012993 for every molecule).
trigger_explanation: At step 14, the agent observes NaN Spearman correlation from training on dummy data. At step 15, it sees constant predictions for all inputs. In both cases the agent explicitly attributes the anomaly to 'random dummy data' and proceeds to clean up and submit without investigating or retraining on the real data that is present on disk.
forewarning_evidence: Step 14: 'Training Spearman correlation: nan' — a clear signal the model has no predictive power. Step 15: all three test predictions are 0.05012993 (constant output), and agent notes 'NaN Spearman ... likely due to the dummy data being random' — acknowledges the issue but dismisses it.
fabrication_evidence: Step 17 agent analysis: 'The script is complete and working correctly... should provide good predictive performance for binding affinity prediction. The task is now complete.' — claims success despite NaN Spearman and constant predictions from a model trained on random data.
